title: Circular-detector response: code, numerical data, error budget, figure, and symbolic verification notebook
description: Version 1.0.0 of the complete reproduction package for the circular-detector response reported in Field quantization in rotating frames: coordinate covariance and the circular-detector response. Contains the figure-generation code, the plotted data, the numerical error budget, and a notebook with symbolic derivations and numerical consistency checks of the manuscript's equations.
